input.body: We are writing to request a review of the $17.50 deduction on order DD-51115, dated 2026-11-04, which was made with the reason "missing item" for the Jhol Momo. Our records show the order was ready at 12:55 and picked up at 12:58, so the handoff to the courier took place 3 minutes after the order was ready [DD-51115:pickup_handoff]. The order ticket for DD-51115 lists Jhol Momo as part of the order as placed. We do not have a packing record beyond this, and we are stating only what our records show. We respectfully ask that you review the deduction and reverse it. We are happy to provide any further information that would help with the review.
